symptom: A branch mxcli wrote cannot be merged: `mx diff` / Studio Pro's merge throw `System.InvalidOperationException: Objects with ID … of type Microflows$LoopedActivity (DomainModels$DateTimeAttributeType, …) do not have the same properties. baseNames = Documentation, …; newNames = …` (exit 129), and the Version Control → Status panel crashes on the document. `mxcli check`, `exec`, `mx check`, the build and the runtime are all green (mendixlabs/mxcli#1373)
cause: Mendix's merge engine compares an element's property NAMES between two revisions before any value, and throws instead of defaulting when they differ. The writers emitted only what `mx check` needs — the legacy serializer's minimum: an empty Documentation on a loop, the empty half of a mutually exclusive Attribute/Association pair, default-valued enums, empty lists — about 95 (type, key) gaps on 11.14, plus keys Mendix does not declare (CloseFormAction.NumberOfPages deleted in 8.11, gen binding TabControl's default tab as DefaultPage instead of DefaultPagePointer, Title.Caption, NavigationListItem.Name, DatabaseConnection.LastSelectedQuery after 11.10). The canon $ID transplant (v0.19) turned each gap into a crash on rewrite — same $ID, different key set — and a NEW element crashes one Studio Pro save later, so it is not only a rewrite problem
file: `modelsdk/canon/propertyset.go` (`CompletePropertySets`, `completionID`) + `modelsdk/canon/studiopro_property_defaults.json` (the measured table), wired at the single write choke point `modelsdk/mpr/writer_core.go` (`completePropertySets`, in `reconcileWithStored` and `insertUnit`) and mirrored by the read-back (`mdl/backend/modelsdk/microflow_readback.go` `completeAsStored`); measurement and table merge in `internal/propertysets` (+ `cmd/propdefaults`); gate `checkPropertySets` in `mdl/executor/property_sets_integration_test.go`, run per doctype script by `TestMxCheck_DoctypeScripts` (`MXCLI_PROPERTY_SETS_RECORD` records); writer fixes in `mdl/backend/modelsdk/microflow_write.go` (loop Documentation, NumberOfPagesToClose), `microflow_read_actions.go` (`closePageCount`), `widget_write.go` (Title, NavigationListItem), `db_write.go` (`storesLastSelectedQuery`), `security_write.go` (UserRole GUID), `mdl/backend/wfmutator/mutator.go` (`InsertBranch` outcome Flow + PersistentId), `modelsdk/gen/pages/types.go` (TabContainer DefaultPagePointer override); tests `mdl/backend/modelsdk/issue1373_property_sets_test.go`, `modelsdk/canon/propertyset_test.go`, `internal/propertysets/propertysets_test.go`
insight: **`mx convert -p` is an oracle for what Studio Pro writes**: it re-serializes exactly the units that are not canonical for its version and — the control — changes 0 units of a pristine project. So write content with mxcli, convert a copy, and every key Mendix ADDS is a gap with Mendix's own default as the value, every key it REMOVES is a key the version does not declare. That turned an open-ended 'which properties are we missing' into a diff, and it found three behaviour bugs hiding behind key-set noise: `close page 2` closed one page (deleted int key), the default tab of a tab control never landed (gen wrong key, not caught by keyaudit because Forms$TabControl maps to metamodel PagesTabContainer), and a Title caption Mendix never had. **A valid model is not a mergeable one**: mx check, the build and the runtime fill absent properties with defaults; only the merge engine compares names. **Fix the class at the choke point, the instances at the writer**: a measured, version-floored table applied where every unit is written closes all ~95 gaps for every writer at once (and is semantically neutral — it is the value Mendix fills in on load), while the keys Mendix does not declare and the values that are wrong are writer bugs. **Measure per version**: run on 10.24 the same corpus showed 20 extra keys mxcli writes that 10.24 does not declare and a `Rest$JsonBody` that makes `mx convert` refuse the whole project — separate issues, invisible on 11.14. **An end-to-end rewrite test must make a real change**, or elision keeps the stored bytes and it passes without the fix **Elements a completion ADDS must get deterministic $IDs** (derived from the owner's $ID and the path, with a collision step like canon.derivedID): random ones made every re-encoding differ, and the raw `call web service` passthrough compares bytes, so a re-run of an unchanged script rewrote the flow — found only by the round-trip suite's re-run property, with a stub of the pass as the control. **Every path that predicts what storage will hold must apply the same pass** (ReadBackMicroflow), or it compares a declared flow without the keys against a stored one with them. **Bound each key by the versions it was MEASURED on, both ends**: a table built from 10.24 and 11.14 wrote 10.24's ConfigurationMicroflow into 11.14 projects (renamed ConfigurationEntityMicroflow) until a re-measurement on 11.14 showed it as an extra; a key gets `until` when a newer measured version exercised the type without it, at the conservative end of the unknown range. Measuring on all six CI versions (10.24.24, 11.6.8, 11.12.2–11.15) lowered most floors and placed the rename between 11.6 and 11.12.
